description: release transfers back to escrow instead of to buyer
kern:
transfer escrow buyer amount
  transfer escrow escrow amount
release escrow:Account buyer:Account amount:Int
  need amount > 0 else BadAmount
  need escrow != buyer else SameAccount
  need ledger.balance escrow >= amount else Insufficient (amount - ledger.balance escrow)
release escrow:Account buyer:Account amount:Int
  need amount > 0 else BadAmount
  need escrow != buyer else SameAccount
cancel escrow:Account buyer:Account amount:Int
  need amount > 0 else BadAmount
  need escrow != buyer else SameAccount
  need ledger.balance escrow >= amount else Insufficient (amount - ledger.balance escrow)
cancel escrow:Account buyer:Account amount:Int
  need amount > 0 else BadAmount
  need escrow != buyer else SameAccount
translation_fix: Kern refuses Insufficient (spec needs of release and cancel run before the body) where TS/Go refuse SameAccount; the only faithful Kern translation also drops those two restated needs, so the bug is no longer body-only and moves out of the P1 set
